name: korzy-research
description: Find US land parcels by address or coordinates, read their records and owners, and check nearby utilities, environmental layers, logistics and data center projects.

interface.longDescription:
Korzy is parcel research for analysts and teams evaluating land in the United States. Look up a parcel by street address or coordinates and read its published record: parcel ID, land use, reported acreage, building size, assessed value and last sale. Owner names and mailing addresses are added only when you ask, at double the credit cost.

Then check what is around the site: water and sewer service areas and treatment plants, flood zones, wetlands and other environmental layers, nearby roads, rail, ports and airports, data center projects, and the parcel's terrain. Answers cite parcel IDs, record dates and units, and say when a record is missing.

The plugin connects to Korzy's MCP server and includes a parcel research skill, a getting-started skill and REST API instructions. It requires a Korzy Professional or Business plan; you sign in with your Korzy account the first time it connects.
defaultPrompt: Look up the parcel at an address I provide and summarize its record.
What parcel is at these coordinates, and what utilities and data centers are nearby?
Check a parcel for flood zones, wetlands and nearby transport.
